## View Categories

`GET localhost:8000/categories`

**Auth:** Not required.

View all categories in the database, optionally filtered by name.

The name search is performed on a normalized category name (lowercased and with whitespace stripped). For example, `"pot"` will match a category named `"Pots and Planters"`.

**Query Parameters**

| Name | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | no | Partial, normalized match on category name |

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `200` | The list of categories | `application/json` array[CategoryRead] |

**CategoryRead**

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | int | yes | The unique category identifier, min (exclusive) `0` |
| `name` | string | yes | The name of the category, min length `1` |

**Auth:** Requires a Bearer token in the `Authorization` header (`Bearer <ACCESS_TOKEN>`). See **Create Token (Login)** to obtain one.

**Request Body** (required) — `application/json` CategoryCreate

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | string | yes | The name of the category, min length `1` |

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `201` | The newly created category | `application/json` CategoryRead |
| `401` | The client is not authenticated | — |
| `422` | Validation Error | `application/json` HTTPValidationError |

**CategoryRead**

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | int | yes | The unique category identifier, min (exclusive) `0` |
| `name` | string | yes | The name of the category, min length `1` |

## View Products for Category

`GET localhost:8000/categories/{id}/products`

**Auth:** Not required.

View a category with a given ID and all its associated products.

**Path Parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | int | yes |  |

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `200` | The category, with its associated products | `application/json` CategoryReadWithProducts |
| `404` | A category with that ID does not exist. | — |
| `422` | Validation Error | `application/json` HTTPValidationError |

**CategoryReadWithProducts**

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | int | yes | The unique category identifier, min (exclusive) `0` |
| `name` | string | yes | The name of the category, min length `1` |
| `products` | array[ProductReadWithoutCategory] | yes | min length `0` |

**ProductReadWithoutCategory**

Represents a product without its parent category. Used here because the product is already nested under its category, so repeating the category would just duplicate data the caller already has.

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | int | yes | The unique product identifier, min (exclusive) `0` |
| `name` | string | yes | The product name, min length `1` |
| `unit` | string | yes | The product's unit of sale, min length `1` |
| `cost_per_unit` | string | yes | Amount the garden center pays suppliers, in dollars per unit, min (exclusive) `0.0` |
| `price_per_unit` | string | yes | Amount the garden center charges customers, in dollars per unit, min (exclusive) `0.0` |
| `quantity_in_stock` | string | yes | Current amount of product in inventory, in stock units, min `0.0` |


**HTTPValidationError**

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `detail` | array[ValidationError] | no |  |

**ValidationError**

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `loc` | array[string \| int] | yes |  |
| `msg` | string | yes |  |
| `type` | string | yes |  |
| `input` | any | no |  |
| `ctx` | object | no |  |

## View Products

`GET localhost:8000/products`

**Auth:** Not required.

View all products in the database, optionally filtered by name and/or unit of sale.

The name search is performed on a normalized product name (lowercased and with whitespace stripped). For example, `"3in"` will match a product named `"3 In. Planter"`.

**Query Parameters**

| Name | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | no | Partial, normalized match on product name |
| `unit` | no | Exact match on unit of sale |

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `200` | The list of products | `application/json` array[ProductRead] |

**ProductRead**

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | int | yes | The unique product identifier, min (exclusive) `0` |
| `name` | string | yes | The product name, min length `1` |
| `unit` | string | yes | The product's unit of sale (e.g. "each", "bag", "lb"), min length `1` |
| `cost_per_unit` | string | yes | Amount the garden center pays suppliers, in dollars per unit, min (exclusive) `0.0` |
| `price_per_unit` | string | yes | Amount the garden center charges customers, in dollars per unit, min (exclusive) `0.0` |
| `quantity_in_stock` | string | yes | Current amount of product in inventory, in stock units, min `0.0` |
| `category` | CategoryRead | yes | The category this product belongs to |

**CategoryRead** (nested under `category`)

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | int | yes | The unique category identifier, min (exclusive) `0` |
| `name` | string | yes | The name of the category, min length `1` |

## Create Product

`POST localhost:8000/products`

**Auth:** Requires a Bearer token in the `Authorization` header (`Bearer <ACCESS_TOKEN>`). See **Create Token (Login)** to obtain one.

Create a new product.

**Request Body** (required) — `application/json` ProductCreate

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | string | yes | The product name, min length `1` |
| `unit` | string | yes | The product's unit of sale (e.g. "each", "bag", "lb"), min length `1` |
| `cost_per_unit` | string | yes | Amount the garden center pays suppliers, in dollars per unit, min (exclusive) `0.0` |
| `price_per_unit` | string | yes | Amount the garden center charges customers, in dollars per unit, min (exclusive) `0.0` |
| `quantity_in_stock` | string | yes | Current amount of product in inventory, in stock units, min `0.0` |
| `category_id` | int | yes | The ID of the category this product belongs to, min (exclusive) `0` |

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `201` | The newly created product | `application/json` ProductRead |
| `401` | The client is not authenticated | — |
| `404` | The category referenced by `category_id` does not exist. | — |
| `422` | Validation Error | `application/json` HTTPValidationError |

**ProductRead** (response body)

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | int | yes | The unique product identifier, min (exclusive) `0` |
| `name` | string | yes | The product name, min length `1` |

| `quantity_in_stock` | string | yes | Current amount of product in inventory, in stock units, min `0.0` |
| `category` | CategoryRead | yes | The category this product belongs to |

| `msg` | string | yes |  |

## Database Check

`GET localhost:8000/db-check`

**Auth:** Not required.

Check the status of the database connection.

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `200` | The connection status | `application/json` DatabaseStatus |

**DatabaseStatus**

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `status` | string | yes | Database connection status |
| `product_count` | int | yes | The number of rows in the product table |

**Example Response Body**

```json
{
  "status": "connected",
  "product_count": 0
}
```

## Create Token (Login)

`POST localhost:8000/tokens`

**Auth:** Not required — this endpoint issues the token used by other endpoints.

Create a new session token in order to access protected endpoints.

**Request Body** (required) — `application/json` UserCredentials

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `username` | string | yes |  |
| `password` | string | yes |  |

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `201` | The token was created successfully. | TokenRead |
| `401` | Invalid username or password provided. | — |
| `422` | Validation Error | `application/json` HTTPValidationError |

**TokenRead**

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `access_token` | string | yes | A JWT for API access |
| `token_type` | string | yes | Always `"bearer"` |

**HTTPValidationError**

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `detail` | array\[ValidationError\] | no |  |

**ValidationError**

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `loc` | array\[string | int\] | yes |  |
| `msg` | string | yes |  |
| `type` | string | yes |  |
| `input` | any | no |  |
| `ctx` | object | no |  |
